_about: Designated smoking areas from operators' own lists (not in NEA's data). The operators publish descriptions only, so each position is the named landmark (OneMap / OpenStreetMap) and the spots are marked approximate. Import with: npm run import:operators. 'official' is the operator's wording; 'name' is the short name shown in the app (max 60 characters).
